build_windows_wrapper: build a WindowsWrapper module that splits input tensors into N equally sized windows for backbone feature extraction
create_windows_wrapper_init: create a WindowsWrapper instance with a backbone, number of horizontal and vertical windows, and patch size parameters
run_windows_wrapper_forward: run the WindowsWrapper forward pass on a NestedTensor to get concatenated window and global features
review_windows_wrapper_forward: review the WindowsWrapper forward method that crops windows, extracts features via backbone, and concatenates results
summarize_windows_wrapper: summarize the WindowsWrapper class that doubles output channels by combining window-level and global-level backbone features
